name: Lumen
tagline: An app made of light: neutral glass over your own wallpaper, and your work on a calm plane framed by it.
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces. The window and everything on it (sidebar, tab bar, title area) is system glass in one neutral tint over your wallpaper; the agent chat, terminal, editor, diffs, pages and Settings sit on a near-solid plane inset in that glass. Depth is the only hierarchy: no painted rims, glows or extra lines. Theme files for color and material (Lumen, dark, the default; Lumen Light), a few settings, and a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for quiet cards and the prompt bubble. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
